Welcome!

📉 R4DEV 📈 is designed to teach you how to do **reproducible data analysis and visualisation** using [**R**](https://www.r-project.org/) and [**RStudio**](https://posit.co/)[^1]. You will learn to handle and import online data, to make all sorts of plots, maps and animations, and even create apps and websites using free open-source tools. [Check out all the things you can expect to learn](https://r4dev.netlify.app/about).

[^1]: Thanks to Zélie, Rebecca, Rossana, Romane, Emma, Shivona, Maëlle and others who tested, often with their patience, earlier versions of this workshop.

The workshop is committed to work with the [**tidyverse**](https://www.tidyverse.org/)[^2].

[^2]: The tidyverse is a collection of R packages designed for data science. All packages share an underlying design philosophy, grammar, and data structures. Install the complete tidyverse with: `install.packages("tidyverse")`. If you prefer base R code, suit yourself but *I do not recommend it*.

All progress is piecemeal, so the workshop is in permanent state of improvement. Make sure you check the website regularly for updates, new material and corrections.
